summary: Verified streak-advances-on-lesson-completion (not login) change end-to-end. Backend pytest: 5/5 passing. Frontend browser test: streak chip stable across 4 dashboard reloads, zero auto /api/streak/checkin calls, no infinite re-render loop. Lesson-completion response contains {streak, streak_reward} and wallet is credited for both lesson coins + streak reward on the first completion of the day. Second-completion-same-day is idempotent (both via re-hitting complete on the same content and via directly calling the legacy /streak/checkin endpoint). Grade 4-5 user's streak_count is correctly exposed on /auth/me for the header chip.

critical_code_review_comments: advance_daily_streak correctly guards against double-advance via last_checkin_date == today early-return; verified idempotent both through re-completing same content and via legacy /streak/checkin.
5-day milestone reward (₹10) logic (streak % 5 == 0) verified in test assertion path.
refreshStreak in Dashboard.jsx uses a functional setUser with a value-equality guard preventing a re-render loop — confirmed by network log (steady ~5 /auth/me per full page load, not runaway).
content.py complete_content_item only calls advance_daily_streak when user.role == 'child' AND only after the 'already completed' early-return — correct scoping.
Response shape from /content/items/{id}/complete always includes streak & streak_reward keys (null / 0 when no advance) so the frontend toast helper can safely optional-chain.
